tagline.id: Skid proses ringkas untuk belajar instrumentasi dan kontrol proses secara langsung.
tagline.en: A compact process skid for hands-on learning of instrumentation and process control.

problem.id: Belajar kontrol proses biasanya hanya lewat teori dan simulasi, karena peralatan industri terlalu besar dan mahal untuk praktik.
problem.en: Process control is usually learned through theory and simulation only, because industrial equipment is too large and expensive for practice.

approach.id: Sistem proses skala kecil di atas skid 250×160×80 cm, dengan 2 tangki proses akrilik 3 L, 2 tangki buffer sekitar 20 L, dan 3 jalur pompa independen yang sengaja dibuat berlebih supaya gangguannya terasa nyata. Jalurnya bisa diatur ulang (single loop, bypass, cross-feed), dan kontrolnya bisa dari on-off, PID, sampai cascade, fuzzy, atau MPC.
approach.en: A small-scale process system on a 250×160×80 cm skid, with 2 acrylic 3 L process tanks, 2 buffer tanks of about 20 L, and 3 independent pump lines deliberately oversized so disturbances feel real. The flow paths can be reconfigured (single loop, bypass, cross-feed), and control goes from on-off to PID, up to cascade, fuzzy, or MPC.
